snapshot.text: Mainly public system run by the Ministry of Health, with health insurance long planned but not fully in place. After a year-long political deadlock a new Kurti-led government was approved in February 2026; the government says 171 doctors returned to Kosovo in 2025.

priorities.title: Renovating university clinics
priorities.text: The government is renovating clinics at the University Clinical Centre, including the Cardiology Clinic.
